name: Harness.io
mood: Midnight DevOps mission control with near-black stacked surfaces, light card borders, Calsans instrument-panel headings, Geist UI copy, pill controls, and a rationed phosphor mint accent.

carbonPlate.role: Primary card surface and main elevated panel.

obsidian.role: Secondary card surface, code blocks, and nested panels.

steelBorder.role: Structural borders, button outlines on dark, and nav separators.

ironEdge.role: Mid-tier surface, dividers, and hover overlays.

cinder.role: Deep muted text, low-priority links, and idle icons.

slateMute.role: Nav borders, inactive nav text, and chrome dividers.

graphite.role: Tertiary body text, subdued labels, and disabled-ish states.

ash.role: Secondary body text, muted descriptions, and helper text.

fog.role: Light card hairline borders on dark surfaces.

cloudMist.role: Secondary light text, soft fills, and muted highlights.

pureWhite.role: Primary text, primary pill fill, and icon strokes.

phosphorMint.role: Accent card fill and highlight surfaces; one per viewport.

signalBlue.role: Link borders, active links, and focus accents.

currentBlue.role: Active nav state, selected menu item, and current-page indicator.

deepSignal.role: Input focus border, form active state, and info stroke.

iceBlue.role: Decorative soft borders and light accent strokes on cards.

verdantEdge.role: Outlined action borders, linked labels, and lightweight green emphasis.

steelIris.role: Cool blue-gray card borders and secondary outlines.

rules: Use Calsans-style type for display and headings.
Use positive 0.056em tracking on Calsans at all sizes.
Do not apply negative tracking to Calsans.
Use Geist for body, navigation, buttons, forms, badges, activity rows, and metadata.
Keep body text around 16px, weight 400, line-height 1.5.

shadows.filledPill: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05) 2px 2px 0px 0px, rgb(255, 255, 255) 0px -1px 0px 0px inset, rgb(255, 255, 255) 1px 0px 0px 0px inset, rgb(255, 255, 255) -1px 0px 0px 0px inset, rgb(255, 255, 255) 0px 1px 0px 0px inset

components.name: Hero Headline
components.recipe: Calsans 88px/300, Pure White, line-height 0.96, 0.056em tracking, optional Phosphor Mint opening phrase.

components.name: Filled Pill Button
components.recipe: Pure White fill, Void Canvas text, 800px radius, 12px by 24px padding, Geist 16px/500.

components.name: Ghost Pill Button
components.recipe: Transparent fill, 1px Pure White border, Pure White text, 800px radius, 12px by 24px padding, Geist 16px/400.

components.name: Dark Surface Card
components.recipe: Carbon Plate fill, 1px Fog border, 20px radius, 24px padding, no shadow.

components.name: Phosphor Accent Card
components.recipe: Phosphor Mint fill, 20px radius, 24px padding, optional Fog border, used at most once per viewport.

components.name: Code Surface
components.recipe: Obsidian fill, 16px radius, 16px to 20px padding, code-like Geist 13px to 14px, nested inside a dark card.

components.name: Navigation Bar
components.recipe: Void Canvas background, about 64px height, logo left, centered Geist 14px links, right-side contact and filled pill CTA.

components.name: Activity Row
components.recipe: Avatar, commit/PR message, metadata, status dot, 10px vertical padding, Iron Edge divider.

components.name: Input Field
components.recipe: Carbon Plate fill, Iron Edge border at rest, Deep Signal focus border, 5px radius, 12px padding, Geist 14px.

components.name: Status Badge
components.recipe: Outlined 800px pill, 2px by 8px padding, Geist 11px to 12px with wide tracking.

components.name: Section Header
components.recipe: Uppercase Geist 12px eyebrow in Ice Blue or Steel Iris followed by Calsans 56px/300 heading.

components.name: 3D Product Visual Block
components.recipe: Dark rendered object or light-ribbon visual on a dark gradient ground, bleeding into Void Canvas.

components.name: Footer Link Column
components.recipe: Geist 14px/500 Pure White heading, 13px to 14px Graphite links, 8px to 16px gaps.

do: Use Calsans for all headlines at 56px or larger with positive 0.056em tracking.
Define card edges with 1px Fog light borders.
Use the filled white pill as the single primary action.
Apply Phosphor Mint to no more than one card or panel per viewport.
Use 20px card radius and 800px pill controls.
Keep body text at Geist 16px/400 with slight positive tracking.
Stack dark surfaces upward from Void Canvas to Carbon Plate to Obsidian.
dont: Do not use drop shadows on cards or panels.
Do not fill buttons with color; only the primary white pill is filled.
Do not use multiple accent colors in one section.
Do not set body text below 14px or above 18px.
Do not apply negative letter-spacing to Calsans.
Do not use dark borders on cards.
Do not break the dark theme with light sections.
